newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at three pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at three pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuedsday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed three percent rate.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on April 23.
An 84.0 billion mark facility set also at a three percent interest rate expires on Wednesday.
A 15-day facility set last week carried an interest rate of three percent, the rate that has prevailed since August.
